import 'package:hazard_fixture/ledger.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // In a process that has just started there is no file of it yet: the
  // test passes with a clear() that does nothing. It leaves the file.
  test('one entry', () {
    clear();
    enter('a');
    expect(entries(), 1);
  });
}
